integrity: Angular diagonalization, endpoint unimodality reduction, unique crossing and asymptotics are analytic; finite computational tests are supplementary and not independent certification.
limitations: Optimization is solely among single centered annuli of fixed Euclidean area, not all measurable masks; asymptotics hold at fixed area or fixed bandwidth as stated. A possible unindexed equivalent optimization remains a priority risk.
title: A sharp finite-band Fock annulus minimax law with an \(N/e\) placement scale
